title: GetDot on DABStep: 450+ financial analysis tasks from Adyen
summary: DABStep is Adyen's benchmark of 450+ multi-step financial analysis tasks. GetDot scored 67% out of the box and 90% after eight hours of training. On the easy tasks it beat trained human analysts, in seconds.
body_markdown:
## You can train GetDot to get better


Out of the box, with no domain context, GetDot scored 67%. Then we gave it context with its context agent, one step at a time:


- **1 hour: 73%.** A data dictionary and the table relationships.
- **2 hours: 80%.** Golden query examples.
- **4 hours: 85%.** Business logic and domain rules.
- **8 hours: 90%.** Instructions for edge cases.


For comparison, Google's Data Science Agent scores about 52%.


## Hours of analysis in seconds


On the easy tasks, trained human analysts at Adyen got 62% right, with more than three hours of work. GetDot got 96% right in about 60 seconds.


On the hard tasks, GetDot got 89% right in about 130 seconds. There is no human baseline for those: they need domain expertise across several files.


Our scores are on the public[DABStep leaderboard](https://huggingface.co/spaces/adyen/DABstep) , as GetDot 0.3.
